recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, high-contrast facial portrait of a woman with dark hair, framed by a vibrant magenta and red neon glow that bleeds into the hair and background. The composition features a clean, ultra-thin geometric title at the top and a loose, energetic handwritten subtitle at the bottom right.
coreVisualRelationships: The magenta glow acts as a vibrant frame for the warm, natural skin tones of the central face.
The ultra-thin, precise top typography contrasts with the messy, organic handwriting at the bottom.
Dark, deep shadows in the background and hair provide a canvas for the saturated neon highlights.
coreInvariants: Extreme close-up framing of the face.
Magenta/red chromatic aberration or halation effect in the hair.
Dual typographic style: one rigid/geometric, one fluid/hand-drawn.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered close-up portrait, filling approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, moves up to the thin geometric header, then follows the magenta hair glow down to the handwritten text in the bottom right corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Deep black negative space at the top corners and bottom center, emphasizing the subject's silhouette.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black and dark brown (background and hair).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant magenta and hot pink (lighting and glow).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation in the accent colors against low-value, dark backgrounds creates a 'glowing' effect.
paletteRestrictions: Avoid cool blues or greens to maintain the warm, energetic pop aesthetic.

letterConstructionRules: Hairline stroke weight for the top text.
Bottom text uses a monolinear, cursive-influenced hand-drawn style with varying baselines.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The letter 'A' in the top text has a crossbar that extends slightly beyond the diagonal strokes.
The 'E' and 'D' in the bottom text feature overlapping loops.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between technical precision (top) and human expression (bottom).

preserve: Hairline weight of the top font

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric structure and ultra-light weight.
Captures the raw, energetic feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a close-up portrait of a woman with dark hair against a black background. Apply a strong magenta and red backlight that creates a glowing halo effect through the strands of her hair. Ensure the face is well-lit with warm tones and soft shadows.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a single line of ultra-thin, wide geometric sans-serif text in white at the very top. Add a second line of white handwritten, marker-style text in the bottom right corner, tilted slightly upward.

verificationChecks: Is the top text thin enough to appear like wireframe?
Does the magenta glow feel integrated into the hair rather than just a flat overlay?
Is the facial lighting warm and clear despite the dark background?

adjustableVariables: Angle of the bottom handwritten text
mustRedesign: Any specific artist names or trademarked logos
Exact facial features of the original subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text is legible against the magenta and black.
Ensure the hair texture looks natural within the glow.
Verify the geometric font has no thick strokes.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a high-contrast studio portrait with a saturated neon rim light and a dual-style typographic layout (technical vs. organic).
